entries.en: to meet each other; to encounter one another
to come upon; to meet with
to meet face to face; to meet in someone's presence
entries.notes: H栏“相病”于义难通，疑为“相並/相面”之讹；据L栏 presencion（当面）与R栏音读定夺。

entries.zh: 意见相左；彼此相背、相抵触
entries.en: to be at odds in opinion; to be contrary to each other
to meet a bad friend; to fall in with an enemy
entries.notes: M栏第2音节标T99污损，H栏“字星”疑难辨（疑“歹星/剋星”），仅依L栏 mal amigo（冤家）定夺，存疑。

entries.zh: 诉诸官府以害人；拦官告状
entries.en: to have recourse to the law so as to harm someone
entries.notes: H栏“鈀路”与L栏不合，M栏混入西语 pezaio 且第4音节T99污损，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 触犯；冒犯（相遇而得罪于人）
entries.en: to offend; to give offence to someone met
entries.notes: L栏 agradándo 疑为 agraviando（得罪）之讹，正与H栏“触纪”（当作“触犯”）相合。

entries.en: to offend; to provoke
entries.notes: 与前条重出；L栏 agradando 疑为 agraviando 之讹。

entries.en: to touch; to run into, to bump against

entries.zh: 触目；令人看不顺眼、有碍观瞻
entries.en: to offend the eye; to be an eyesore
entries.notes: L栏 el muerto…los guesos 语义晦涩（疑指见尸骨之骇目），H栏“触人目”义明，取H。

entries.zh: 冲撞；相撞、撞倒（争斗中撞跌，落入坑穴）
entries.en: to collide; to knock against (in a quarrel, so that one falls into a pit)
entries.notes: M栏第2音节T99污损；L栏 fozia 当即 fosa（坑/墓穴）。

entries.zh: 遭其毒手；落入他手中受害
entries.en: to fall into his hands; to come to harm at his hands
entries.notes: H栏“遭伊手”为受害义，与L栏 hacelle mal（害他）主客方向相反，依H栏定。

entries.en: to encounter; to come across by chance

entries.zh: 遭遇；碰上（多指不期而遇及其所遇之境）
entries.en: to encounter; to meet with (often adversity)
entries.notes: M栏衍出 iyiū、iō xien 等音节，疑为释语混入；H栏“遭遇”义明。

entries.en: a chance encounter; a remarkable meeting
entries.notes: M栏 bōng gū 等音节疑为释语混入，H栏“奇遇”义明。

entries.en: a rare meeting; a chance encounter
entries.notes: M栏 siâng hōng 为重出之音，H栏义明。

entries.en: to meet by chance; a chance meeting
entries.notes: M栏第3音节T99污损，H栏“邂逅”义明。

entries.en: to meet on the road; to come upon head-on
to bump heads; to run into head-on

entries.zh: 仇雠；冤家对头（赌局或争斗中相向）
entries.en: foes, enemies; to be pitted against each other in play or quarrel
entries.notes: M栏混入西语 en el pleito o riña，R栏 chîn chîn 与“仇讎”常读不合，取H栏。

entries.en: to happen to meet; to chance upon
by chance; as it happens
